entities.summary: Zaynulla Rasulev was a Bashkir religious leader in the 19th and early 20th century. Zaynulla is also embraced by the closely related Tatars as part of their religious legacy. Zaynulla is notable as one of the most important representatives of Jadidism and the organizer of one of the first Jadidi madrasah. Zaynulla belonged to the Naqshandi Sufi order.
